Specification: This module specifies a simple mathematical model of Pascal's triangle using a recursively defined function of two arguments. It defines a bounded range 0..N with N fixed to 5, computes the triangle value tri[n, k] recursively, and stores one selected value tri[4, 2] in the state variable result. The specification includes an initial predicate, a stuttering-only next-state action, and an invariant asserting that the computed result equals 6; there is no fault model, no fairness, and no temporal liveness property beyond the state/action structure.
IfThenElse: IF k > n \/ (k = 0 /\ n = 0) THEN 1 ELSE tri[n - 1, k - 1] + tri[n - 1, k]
